verdict.rationale: Oneleet supports SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA. Its framework-removal docs say controls are automatically added per framework and are kept when another framework requires them, which implies one control can be shared across frameworks. There is no explicit documentation that evidence collected for SOC 2 automatically satisfies ISO 27001 or HIPAA requirements, and nothing describes an overlap view. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-framework evidence reuse, an overlap or mapping visualization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
